versions.changelog: Security hardening: changed high-impact behaviors to opt-in defaults (autoInjectInstructions=false, autoMigrateLegacy=false), removed startup systemPrompt override path, and kept explicit config-based enablement for instruction context injection and legacy migration.

Fixes lockfile/package mismatch causing npm ci failures. Adds robust QMD runtime compatibility handling (including Node ABI/better-sqlite3 mismatch detection) with automatic fallback to basic mode instead of startup crashes. Documents Node/QMD compatibility guidance and fallback env flag.

Security hardening: cleaned release artifacts to remove legacy v1 OpenAI/LanceDB files, added prepublish release verification, removed stale embedding/apiKey type surface, added explicit autoMigrateLegacy control, and hardened QMD execution plus local fallback search when QMD is unavailable.
Remove OpenAI dependency, fix security scan issues
v2: File-based storage with QMD search, auto-migration from v1
Fix: include built dist/ in published package; add prepublishOnly script
Fix database initialization race conditions that caused 'Database not initialized' errors on startup

fix: close
  LanceDB connection and reset state on service stop (fixes SIGUSR1 restart
  issue)
Switch from better-sqlite3 to sql.js (WASM) - eliminates NODE_MODULE_VERSION errors across different Node.js versions
Add explicit Docker gateway start command
Improved install docs with Docker instructions and troubleshooting
Fix: auto-create database directory on first run
Fix: make embedding config optional (auto-uses OPENAI_API_KEY env var)
Improved installation docs with proper plugin activation steps
Initial release - agent-controlled memory with confidence scoring
